saints.name: St. Frumentius
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: A shipwrecked youth who became the apostle and first bishop of Ethiopia…
biography: According to the ancient historians, Frumentius and his brother Aedesius, boys from Tyre, were the survivors of a shipwreck on the Red Sea coast and were carried to the court of the king of Axum in Ethiopia. Rising to positions of trust, Frumentius encouraged the Christian merchants there and prepared the way for the conversion of the land.

Traveling to Alexandria, he asked St. Athanasius to send a bishop for the growing Church, and Athanasius consecrated Frumentius himself for the task. Returning to Ethiopia, he baptized the king and countless others, so that he is honoured as the apostle of that nation and its first bishop, remembered by the Ethiopians as “Abba Salama,” Father of Peace.
